heroLead: We welcome partners who want to build shared value across the group's six business sectors. Partnership programme details are still being prepared.
introLead: Collaboration is part of how we work. We look for partners who complement the ecosystem and bring real impact.

points.title: A broad portfolio
points.text: Six sectors and twelve units provide room to test ideas together.

points.text: Units operate in one district, making cross-sector collaboration easier.

points.title: A long-term approach
points.text: We prioritise relationships that grow and benefit both sides.
